title: Personal Site Agent: Free AI chatbot trained on your website content | Product Hunt
excerpt: Personal Site Agent helps you create an AI chatbot that learns directly from your website content. Install one script, crawl your website, and let visitors get instant answers 24/7. Capture leads, customize the chatbot, review conversations, transfer chats to WhatsApp, and even use your own OpenAI API key. It's currently free to use and requires no coding, making it perfect for businesses, agencies, and website owners.
